'''Yasuyuki Kase''' (Japanese: '''加瀬康之''' ''Kase Yasuyuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kase was born on Mar 14, 1971 in {{wp|Ōta}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during the [[M19|nineteenth movie]], where he voiced [[Levi]], one of the main antagonists. In {{aniseries|SM}}, Kase gained his most notable role as [[Guzma]], the leader of [[Team Skull]]. Kase is currently affiliated with the talent agency Office Osawa.
